name: AI Persona — <YOUR NAME>
firstMessage: Hi! I'm <YOUR NAME>'s AI representative. I can tell you about my background and experience, or set up a call — what would you like to know?
_setup_notes: Auth: in the Vapi custom-LLM credential, paste BRAIN_API_TOKEN as the API key (sent as Authorization: Bearer). If your Vapi plan doesn't send it, append &key=<BRAIN_API_TOKEN> to the model.url instead.
mode=voice in the URL makes the brain return short, spoken-style replies.
Attach a phone number to this assistant in the Vapi dashboard (import a Twilio US number or use a Vapi-provided number).
